sources.observed: Google designer specifies matte glass back, polished aluminum enclosure, bead-blasted camera face and high-polished sidewalls. Also specifies flat glass.
sources.quote: The camera bar features a bead-blasted top surface and high-polished sidewalls

sources.observed: Google describes silky matte back, polished frame and diamond-cut camera bar. Macro image shows diffuse camera face, narrow polished rim and reflective enclosure.
Victus2 silky matte back and polished-finish aluminum frame. Material identity alone does not determine shader numbers.

code_audit.make_pixel_profiles.py: Pixel9Pro already separates back/rail/bar/black. Rail metal1 rough.18, back nonmetal rough.42, camera bar metal.6 rough.30. Rail RGB is derived from backRGB*.65+.20, an artistic estimate. The single bar role loses the official camera dual finish.
code_audit.make_device_branding.py: Adds logo contours and finish-tinted logo role only. No rail or antenna construction.
code_audit.geometry.py: Separate enclosure, rear glass, front black glass, camera housing and optical layers exist. No procedural antenna API. camera_assembly uses bar role across all housing faces.
code_audit.build.py: Imported Pixel10Pro keeps source materials. --finish updates Base Color only, ignoring metal/rough values. Default source Obsidian RGB differs from --finish Obsidian palette; do not bundle this unrelated palette change into a seam correction.
code_audit.pixel10_source: Four side strips, each0.7mm long-axis width and6.5mm depth coverage, atY+52/-60mm; no top/bottom antenna meshes. Enclosure depth8.55mm. Camera housing also has a black cavity material slot that must be preserved. Existing actual bottom-port recesses must remain.

prototype.activation: blender -b --python research/prototype_pixel_rails.py -- pixel-9-pro --antennas (or pixel-10-pro). No default build hook.
prototype.materials: Preserves current camera face and black cavity materials. Copies face RGB into sidewall material using existing polished rail metal/rough values. Pixel9Pro dual finish explicitly specified by Google; Pixel10Pro division inferred from macro image, qualified as a study.
prototype.antennas: Six model-specific surface patches clipped from copied actual enclosure mesh, preserving existing outline and front/rear edge rolls. 3-micrometre offset avoids coplanar flicker. Replaces four old ribbons in temporary Pixel10Pro scene. This is surface appearance, not through-cut CAD inserts.
prototype.excluded: No corner/display/lens/port geometry change; no invented mmWave/SIM hardware; no extrapolation to other models/finishes/regions.

proposed_minimal_api.camera: Optional camera.side_material. After cavity booleans, assign only original exterior housing polygons with non-rear-facing normals to that role; preserve black cavity slots. Separate bar_side role shares barRGB but uses polished rail metal/rough. Opt in Pixel9Pro only initially; imported Pixel10Pro needs equivalent instance assignment.
proposed_minimal_api.antenna: Optional profile.antenna_breaks explicit edge/center_axis_mm/width_mm/material entries. Clip existing enclosure surface with measured per-model coordinates; no generation ratio or generic bands.
proposed_minimal_api.hook: If adopted, apply_pixel_rail_details(profile,root) after imported/procedural creation, before parts=[root,*root.children_recursive], prepare_screen, checks and export. Honor explicit imported material metal/rough overrides. No shared files edited by this audit.
